title: Dependency Manifest Crypto Presence Without Code Invocations
description: Tests whether discovery tools correctly distinguish declared package dependencies from actual source code invocations.

expected_findings.evaluation_notes: Bouncy Castle is a provider/library package, NOT a cryptographic algorithm. Component coordinates org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on:1.78.1 are declared as dependency evidence in pom.xml. Algorithm usage is UNKNOWN / NOT_OBSERVED because DirectService.java contains zero cryptographic invocations. Operational role is unknown. Tools must not infer active algorithm usage (e.g. RSA, AES) merely from dependency manifest presence.

verification_metadata.verification_method: Manual Manifest Audit & Source Code Absence Verification
